events.title: Lara Louise-A Keys Birthday Celebration!
events.description: Join us as one of the Bay Area's most beloved rising artists helps us celebrate four years at Keys! Keys Jazz Bistro welcomes Dutch-born vocalist Lara Louise for an evening of classic songs, characterized by a soft, sultry voice blending her folk roots with French chanson, Bossa Nova, and the Great American Songbook.
